thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a cutover tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. runtime v2.3.1 + api v1.9. Console and router need to be pinned during canary. Deploy bot will run a 5% canary first.

shreya: Ack. I can pin console routes, but want to confirm API contract changes — any breaking header changes?

maria: No breaking headers. Just a small client schema tweak for debug metadata. Console team already agreed to backward-tolerate.

tom: Router note — we need header-split enabled for the first 10m so we can route 95% old / 5% new and do abrupt rollback if needed. Also will watch kv-eviction metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary for services:
```
deploy --service runtime --image runtime:v2.3.1 --canary=5% --tag canary-7654
deploy --service api --image api:v1.9 --canary=5% --tag canary-7654
```
ETA ~6m for initial canary. Will emit events: deploy-bot/canary_started, canary_healthy, canary_failed.

ops-sre: Adding SLO check hooks. Canary abort if error_rate > 2.5% OR p95_latency > 500ms for 2min window. Also auto-fallthrough to api:v1.8 if runtime canary fails.

kevin: For rollback criteria — let's keep a manual gate for console pin removal. If canary fails, I want ops-sre to trigger rollback and @shreya to confirm console unpin.

shreya: Sounds good. I'll prepare the console pin command and a quick checklist in the release notes.

maria: Release notes draft: "runtime: v2.3.1 - batching kernel fix; api: v1.9 - client debug metadata schema (backwards compatible). Observability: add runtime/kernel-batch-miss metric." Link: https://gist.github.com/redwood/release-notes-7654

tom: Preflight checklist I ran locally:
- smoke ingest tests: pass
- header-split routing: validated in staging
- kv cache priming: OK
- perf run p95: 120ms baseline

maria: Good. Deploy plan:
1) start canary 5% runtime+api
2) wait 10m, observe deploy-bot/canary_healthy plus SLO hooks
3) if healthy, ramp to 25% for 15m, then 100% in waves
4) console pin remains until 100% mature

deploy-bot: canary_started @channel (ts: 7654321120)

ops-sre: saw a small spike in runtime kernel-batch-miss on first warmup (~0.7% -> 1.8%) — within tolerance. continuing watch. :eyes:

kevin: If we see sustained error_rate > 1.5% during ramp to 25% let’s pause and triage. Manual rollback plan: deploy-bot rollback --tag canary-7654 then pin api to v1.8/runtime to last-stable; router will route back to old variant.

shreya: Console pin command (dry-run): `consolectl pin-route --service api --version v1.8 --until 03:30Z` I’ll be ready to run if ops asks.

deploy-bot: canary_healthy (ts: 7654321800) — metrics OK, SLO checks passed.

maria: Ramp to 25% now. Router will update split.

tom: Split updated: 75/25 old/new. Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/deploy-7654

ops-sre: No errors, latency stable. Proceed to full rollout in 20m if stable.

maria: One more ask — add a short note in the release email that console users may see extra debug metadata field until client library is rolled. Nothing breaking.

kevin: Agreed. If anything looks off during the final 100% ramp, we'll hit rollback. Ops has the trigger.

deploy-bot: final_rollout_started (ts: 7654323700) — ramping to 100% in waves, will report completion or failures.

shreya: Unpin scheduled 15m after final_rollout_started, unless a rollback is requested. I’ll wait for ops signal.

deploy-bot: rollout_complete (ts: 7654324000) — rollout succeeded, all canary and SLO checks green.

maria: Thanks team. Please add any postmortem notes if you observed anomalies. I’ll finalize release notes and close the change window. :tada:
